claims.source_quote_ar: الأصل أن يقدر الشيء في مكانه الأصلي لئلا يخالف الأصل
claims.claim_ar: قاعدة: «الأصل أن يقدر الشيء في مكانه الأصلي لئلا يخالف الأصل» — قاعدة عامة في التقدير تمنع إبقاء المحذوف بلا تقدير في موضعه الأصلي.
claims.claim_en: Rule: “The principle is that the thing should be supplied (taqdir) in its original position so as not to violate the basic order” — a general rule on supplying elided elements in their original place.

claims.claim_en: Example illustrating the rule: it is permissible to supply an elided element in its original place (e.g. “Zaydan ra'aytuhu” — supplying the thing). Depending on context, a supply (taqdir) might be required in a construction like “shadid al-quwa”.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited text offers the example but does not state that any specific elision occurs in S53:A5; applying the example to this aya is conjectural and requires verification from tafsir/fi’l-i‘rab on this verse.
